test_title: SSC CPO 2024 Official Paper-I (Held On: 28 Jun, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: As per the National Multidimensional Poverty Index Report 2023, which of the following states has the least population concentration in the Multidimensional poverty index?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kerala**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kerala** has the least population concentration in the Multidimensional Poverty Index as per the National Multidimensional Poverty Index Report 2023.
 
• The Multidimensional Poverty Index (MPI) assesses multiple deprivations in health, education, and standard of living within a population.
 
• Kerala's strong social indicators, high literacy rate, and robust public health system contribute to its low MPI.
 
• The state's focus on human development and inclusive growth has significantly reduced poverty levels.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The National Multidimensional Poverty Index is a comprehensive measure that captures the acute deprivations faced by people in their daily lives in terms of health, education, and living standards.
 
• It is aligned with the global MPI developed by the Oxford Poverty and Human Development Initiative (OPHI) and the United Nations Development Programme (UNDP).
 
• The report aims to provide a more nuanced understanding of poverty and to assist policymakers in crafting targeted interventions to alleviate poverty.
 
• Other states with low MPI include Goa, Sikkim, and Tamil Nadu, reflecting their relatively better performance in various human development indicators.
 
• The index highlights the importance of multi-faceted approaches to poverty alleviation, beyond merely income-based measures.
